name: Rockchip RK3588 Datasheet Rev 1.9
notes: Datasheet: 4 channels x 16-bit (64-bit total) LPDDR4/4X/5/5X, up to 32 GB address space; it does not state GB/s. 68.3 GB/s is the theoretical peak derived from LPDDR5X-8533 x 64-bit (LPDDR5-5500 = 44 GB/s, LPDDR4X-4266 = 34.1 GB/s). NPU (6 TOPS) shares this system memory.
